title: Lighting
guidance: One flowing present-tense paragraph, under about 200 words.
Start with the main action, then movement and gestures, appearance, environment, camera, lighting and colour.
LTX-2.5 audio: describe ambient sound, put dialogue in quotes with the speaker, name any music.
Say where the light comes from and how it feels. One main lighting setup per shot.

entries.label: Soft key light
entries.prompt: Lighting is a large soft key light from the side, with gentle shadows and flattering skin tones.

entries.label: Rim light
entries.prompt: A strong rim light outlines the subject, separating them from a dark background.

entries.label: Practical lights
entries.prompt: Lighting comes from practical sources in the scene, such as lamps, neon signs and screens, giving warm pools of light.

entries.label: Overcast diffuse
entries.prompt: Overcast daylight is soft and even, with no harsh shadows and muted tones.

entries.label: Hard noon sun
entries.prompt: Hard midday sun casts crisp, short shadows and bright, punchy highlights.

entries.label: Candlelight
entries.prompt: Candlelight flickers warmly, casting soft orange pools of light and deep, moving shadows.

entries.label: Golden backlight
entries.prompt: Low golden sun backlights the subject, creating a glowing edge and long soft shadows.

entries.label: Studio high key
entries.prompt: Bright high-key studio lighting, evenly lit, with clean highlights and minimal shadows.

entries.label: Neon glow
entries.prompt: Coloured neon light spills across faces and wet surfaces, in magenta and cyan.
